htn_kidney.title: PCSK9 contributes to diabetes-associated chronic kidney injury beyond LDL cholesterol regulation: genetic and observational evidence.
htn_kidney.journal: QJM : monthly journal of the Association of Physicians
htn_kidney.authors: Quan J, Li S, Peng J
htn_kidney.zhSummary: 该文聚焦高血压肾病，属于临床研究。核心观点：本研究整合了孟德尔随机化 (MR) 和观察数据，以调查 PCSK9 和 LDL-C 在各种病因的慢性肾损伤 (CKI) 中的因果作用，重点关注与糖尿病相关的 CKI。 临床提示：我们使用 GWAS 摘要统计数据进行了两样本 MR 分析，以评估循环 PCSK9、LDL-C 和 PCSK9 抑制剂调节的 LDL-C 对 CKI 风险的影响，并辅以 1 项为期 5 年的前瞻性队列研究。
htn_kidney.abstract: This study integrates Mendelian randomization (MR) and observational data to investigate the causal roles of PCSK9 and LDL-C in chronic kidney injury (CKI) of various etiologies, with a focus on diabetes-associated CKI. We performed two-sample MR analyses using GWAS summary statistics to assess the effects of circulating PCSK9, LDL-C, and PCSK9-inhibitor-modulated LDL-C on CKI risk, complemented by a 5-year prospective cohort study of 101 type 2 diabetes patients evaluating serum PCSK9 and composite renal endpoints. portal_hypertension.title: External Validation of Laboratory-Based Models to Assess Portal Hypertension Severity in Patients with Compensated Chronic Liver Disease.
portal_hypertension.authors: Mohammed FS, Xing M, Mohnasky M
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：我们的目的是对最初在欧洲队列中开发的两个此类模型进行外部验证，用于预测临床显着的门静脉高压（​​CSPH；肝静脉压力梯度 [HVPG] ≥ 10 mmHg）和严重门静脉高压（​​HVPG ≥ 16 mmHg）。 临床提示：我们的目的是对最初在欧洲队列中开发的两个此类模型进行外部验证，用于预测临床显着的门静脉高压（​​CSPH；肝静脉压力梯度 [HVPG] ≥ 10 mmHg）和严重的门脉高压。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Non-invasive laboratory-based models have been proposed to estimate portal hypertension severity in patients with compensated advanced chronic liver disease (cACLD), but external validation in diverse populations remains limited. We aimed to externally validate two such models, originally developed in European cohorts, for predicting clinically significant portal hypertension (CSPH; hepatic venous pressure gradient [HVPG] ≥ 10 mmHg) and severe portal hypertension (HVPG ≥ 16 mmHg) in a U.S.-based cACLD cohort. portal_hypertension.journal: Clinics and research in hepatology and gastroenterology
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：本综述提出了一个区分短暂性（<6 个月）与慢性（>6 个月）肝脏生化异常的结构化框架，特别关注药物性肝损伤 (DILI)，包括囊性纤维化跨膜电导调节 临床提示：肝脏生化异常很常见，可能反映良性短暂变化或潜在的肝脏疾病。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Liver biochemistry abnormalities are common and may reflect benign transient changes or underlying liver disease. An evidence-based, stepwise approach can optimize diagnostic efficiency while minimizing unnecessary testing in the pediatric population with cystic fibrosis (CF). This review presents a structured framework to differentiate transient (<6 months) from chronic (>6 months) liver biochemistry abnormalities, with a particular focus on drug-induced liver injury (DILI), including cystic fibrosis transmembrane conductance regulator (CFTR) modulators-associated hepatotoxicity and emerging fatty liver disease or metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). portal_hypertension.abstract: Physicians often use caution when prescribing statins to patients with chronic liver disease (CLD) due to potential hepatotoxicity. However, recent evidence indicates that hepatotoxicity is uncommon, and the risks of not using statins may often outweigh those associated with their use. Additionally, recent findings suggest that statins may have clinically beneficial effects on cirrhosis due to their pleiotropic properties. portal_hypertension.title: Innovations in liver disease assessment: clinical insights from spleen stiffness measurement in chronic liver diseases.
portal_hypertension.authors: Wu ZG, Yang L, Wu MB
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于综述研究。核心观点：门脉高压的无创评估对于风险分层和临床决策至关重要。 临床提示：本综述总结了关于主要慢性肝病病因的 SSM 的最新证据，包括病毒性肝炎、代谢相关脂肪性肝病和自身免疫性肝病。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Chronic liver diseases are a major global health burden, with cirrhosis and portal hypertension driving morbidity and mortality. Non-invasive assessment of portal hypertension is critical for risk stratification and clinical decision-making. Spleen stiffness measurement (SSM) has emerged as a novel elastography-based biomarker reflecting the hemodynamic consequences of portal hypertension. This review summarizes current evidence on SSM across major chronic liver disease etiologies, including viral hepatitis, metabolic-associated fatty liver disease, and autoimmune liver diseases.
